name: mjolnir-monorepo
description: Mjolnir Enterprise Load & Stress Testing Platform Monorepo

scripts.dev: npx -y pnpm@latest --filter @mjolnir/shared-types build && npx -y pnpm@latest --filter mjolnir-desktop run dev
scripts.build: npx -y pnpm@latest run build:types && npx -y pnpm@latest -r run build
scripts.package: npx -y pnpm@latest run build && npx -y pnpm@latest --filter mjolnir-desktop exec electron-builder --publish never
